apis.reviewer_notes: Document this as numpy.linalg.norm. For generated tests, use small finite arrays. For keepdims=True, compare to an oracle that also preserves dimensions. Do not make broad invalid-axis exception claims; different invalid axes may raise TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError, or AxisError.

Document this as numpy.dot. For generated tests, use small finite bounded numeric arrays and avoid NaN, infinities, and huge complex values unless explicitly testing them. Use allclose for floating/complex results. Do not assert that out is returned for scalar dot results.

Document this as numpy.strings.add. The Python module exposes the add ufunc imported from numpy. For generated tests, import numpy.strings.add from the installed/runtime NumPy namespace. Restrict tests to string-like inputs. Do not claim that numeric operands are rejected because the exposed ufunc may dispatch to numeric addition. For bytes dtype, avoid null bytes in generated data.
